head_commit.message:
fix(smoke): drive the assessment page with its real selector

The tour clicked `.choice`, which the assessment page never renders — its
options are `button.assess-choice`. Nothing was answered, no run was saved, and
case 12 failed on the tag build. Also drop the '同源异途' text check: it only
holds when a family happens to have cognate members; the assertion is about the
dossier rendering with real rows.

head_commit.message:
fix(smoke): drive the assessment page with its real selector

Backport of the tour fix onto 0.8.1: the assessment page renders
`button.assess-choice`, so the tour must click that (or `.choice` as a
fallback) before the Next button enables. Without this, case 12 answered
nothing, saved no run and failed the tag build.

head_commit.message:
fix(package,smoke): require the readable content set, restore and extend the Windows gate (0.8.1)

Packaging
- courses/families and courses/assessment/items.json are now required resources:
  the build fails if the dossier count is under 12, a family has fewer than five
  members, the bank holds fewer than 60 items, ids repeat, an item has no answer
  key or explain, or the five dimensions are incomplete. A missing readable copy
  was previously still a "successful" build.
- courses/CONTENT-HASHES.json records a sha256 per dossier and for the item bank,
  so a reviewer can tell whether the copy they are reading is the one that
  shipped, without unpacking the JS bundle.
- README.txt now says plainly that courses/ is a read-only copy compiled into the
  binary: editing those JSON files does not change the app.

Smoke (back to 11 cases plus one new one)
- case 11 (w38d2, five boundary items) had been lost from the script; restored.
- case 12 tours the two pages added in 0.8.0: the family dossier must list real
  members and show an induction prompt, and the assessment page must be
  answerable and persist a finished run. Both are asserted from the payload the
  renderer writes (WORDROOTS_SELFTEST_TOUR), not from a screenshot.

Docs
- scripts/word-status-report.mjs owns the numbers block in docs/WORD_STATUS.md;
  CI runs --check, so the documented distribution cannot drift from the lexicon
  again (it had already drifted from the release notes within a day).

Data accuracy
- the resolution cues now cover spect/spectr, so inspect/prospect/circumspect no
  longer sit as "partial": verified segmentation 1286 -> 1307, partial 161 -> 140.

feat(etymology,assessment): cross-verified sources, tighter quizSafe, assessment history in SQLite (0.9.0)

Etymology verification
- analysis/etymology-verification/ holds records fetched from Wiktionary: the URL,
  the entry, a verbatim quote and whether it supports our claim. scripts/
  merge-etymology-verification.mjs folds them into reviews.json without dropping
  the textbook citation; scripts/audit-reviews.mjs now grades evidence in five
  separate levels (registered, located, supported, independent, reviewed) instead
  of "has a source field".
- L7b (all five levels) goes 0 -> 14 morphemes. L7a stays 211 and is reported
  beside it, so the definition change cannot read as progress.
- corrections found while verifying: salary's "salt money" story has no
  contemporaneous evidence and is now marked contested; cx-leg was conflating
  lex "law", legere "read" and log "speech" into one morpheme and is now split,
  with the homograph written down; territory was not usable as evidence for
  cx-terr so it was replaced rather than forced.

quizSafe
- no longer "the parts resolve". It now also requires a known etymology, no
  contested reading and no genuinely missing morpheme record: 1305 -> 989. An
  auto-graded item must not teach the losing side of a disputed origin.

Assessment storage
- new table assessment_runs (id, mode, item_bank_version, times, payload), schema
  v3, commands assessment_list/save/clear/count registered.
- localStorage history is imported once on first launch, idempotently, keeping
  the old data as a rollback; a corrupt payload is skipped and counted rather
  than failing startup; export/import carry assessment_run and a v2 backup
  without the field still imports without wiping history.

Coverage (method unchanged): L6 207 -> 211 because allomorph indexing and
evidence-first resolution fixed exercises that were counted as unresolved.
LESSON bundle, course index, word-status doc and review audit all regenerate in
CI; 275 tests across 13 files.
